reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing shared isEligibleForMonthAction and getMonthActionCategories used by every month-wide action, including setMonthAverage.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is decided once in isEligibleForMonthAction, and the duplicate hidden filter in getMonthActionCategories' SQL is removed.

placement.why: The flag lands in the shared eligibility predicate in budget/actions.ts where the rest of the selection rule already lives.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing and a test.

maintainability.why: Clean single-rule change; the new MonthActionOptions type is used by setZero and setLastMonthSpending while copyPreviousMonth and the average actions still inline the same argument shape.
